title: zkfresh
tagline: Decentralized marketplace on zk technology. Sell and buy what you need.
description: My project allows users around the world to buy and sell goods and services, send and receive them both online and offline. Register once and enjoy all the benefits of WEB3. You can be either a seller or a buyer, do what you are better at. And all of this will work on the blockchain using zk technology.
how_its_made: The project is in the very early stages of development. As such, we are just still considering which blockchain to launch on and what infrastructure to use. If you have experience or thoughts on this then please get in touch. If you have a desire to become part of the team, join us, we need people who can help build and launch our project.
